description:
Reads two Lenormand cards as a pair: the first is the subject, the second describes it, so order matters. Returns the reading, the reading in the other order and the combined tone. Composed from per-card phrases we wrote, not a copied pair table.

[Group: Tarot: Lenormand]
[Endpoint: POST /v1/tarot/lenormand/combination]
[Required: cards]
[Cost: 10 credits (Tier 1)]

cards.description: Two Lenormand slugs in reading order, e.g. ["heart", "ring"].

name: astroway_tarot_lenormand_combination
title: Lenormand: Pair Combination
